_comment: Model tiers the agent CLI accepts as a --model alias, and which effort levels each supports. Hand-maintained: add an entry only when a genuinely new tier ships. Aliases (not pinned model ids) are deliberate — an alias follows the vendor's current model for that tier, so this file does not go stale on every release. `efforts: []` means the tier does not accept an effort parameter at all; the resolver drops a defaulted effort for such a model and REFUSES an explicitly-set one.

models.label: Fable
models.blurb: Mythos-class tier above Opus. The most capable model available.

models.label: Opus
models.blurb: Most capable. The default for agents you talk to and for judgement-heavy work.

models.label: Sonnet
models.blurb: Strong and substantially cheaper. Good for long-running headless work.

models.label: Haiku
models.blurb: Fastest and cheapest, for mechanical work. Does not support effort levels.
